### ✨ New Patches 
📱 Apps from the same developer (same purchase_buy__ string)

    Voice Changer (voicechanger.voiceeffects.soundeffects.voiceavatar) — Unlock Premium features

    My Diary (mydiary.journal.diary.diarywithlock.diaryjournal.secretdiary) — Unlock Premium features

    Music Player (mymusic.offlinemusicplayer.mp3player.playmusic) — Unlock Premium features

    Ringtone Maker (ringtonemaker.musiccutter.customringtones.freeringtonemake) — Unlock Premium features

    To‑Do List (todolist.scheduleplanner.dailyplanner.todo.reminders) — Unlock Premium features

    Calendar (calendar.agenda.calendarplanner.agendaplanner) — Unlock Premium features

🌍 Global apps

    Adobe Lightroom (com.adobe.lrmobile) — Unlock Premium

    MX Player Pro (com.mxtech.videoplayer.pro) — Disable ads and unlock Pro

    Spotify (com.spotify.music) — Unlock Premium

    Nova Launcher (com.teslacoilsw.launcher) — Unlock Prime

    Telegram (org.telegram.messenger) — Unlock Premium

    Wearfit Pro (com.wakeup.howear) — Unlock VIP

🛠️ Utility apps

    ZArchiver (ru.zdevs.zarchiver) — Unlock Premium and bypass login

    TrebEdit (com.teejay.trebedit) — Unlock Premium

    Photex Companion (pl.mobimax.photex) — Unlock Premium

    Camera Opus Companion (pl.mobimax.cameraopus) — Unlock Premium

🎵 Media & lifestyle apps

    Arc Player (com.videoplayer.arcplayer) — Unlock Premium

    Days Matter (com.clover.daysmatter) — Unlock Pro

    Huanxiu (com.huanxiu.HXAweme) — Unlock SVIP

    Screen Translate (com.spaceship.screen.textcopy) — Unlock Premium

    Money App (com.chenupt.money) — Unlock permanent VIP

    Guitar Tuner (com.yaunquan.guitartuna) — Unlock Premium

🐛 Fixes

    Fixed App icon color must be 0xRRGGBB format error in Compatibility.kt files

    Removed duplicate object SpotifyCompatibility declaration

    Added missing imports for VoiceChangerCompatibility

⚠️ Important

Some patches are marked as experimental (isExperimental = true) and may cause instability. Test them on a copy of the APK first.
